description: Use this when the user asks which players are most like a given player this season, how often a player reaches a number (20 points, 10 rebounds, a double-double; with or without a teammate), or how players of his position did against his next opponent lately. Returns, for a player_id, the players most like him by Keel Impact and role (NFL: by his group's main numbers), his milestones (NBA: the share of games reaching each mark), and (NBA) his position group against the next opponent over its last games: the record against the closing line for every caller, each game's row with Keel Stats Pro (`account.held` says when it was left out). Not for his own averages: use player_profile.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

stat.description: Optional NBA stat code for the comparable matchup ("pts" default, "reb", "ast", "tpm", "pra"…).

without_player_id.description: Optional, NBA milestones: only the games this teammate missed.

name: player_comparables
title: Similar Players, Milestones & Comparable Matchups
